title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1991-03-27
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Behringer UltraMatch SRC2000 ->  SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude v7.02 Professional -> SHN
source: Set 2 FOB Schoeps CMC3/MK4 (ORTF)> Oade Preamp> Dat (Panasonic SV255/48k)

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience bootleg with noisy ambience, but a solid concert highlighted by strong Phil Lesh bass work.
ai_review.review: The recording is an indistinct, audience‑sourced bootleg captured in a noisy auditorium, resulting in poor clarity and a generally muddy mix. Despite the sub‑par audio, reviewers describe the performance as pretty good, especially noting that Lesh sounds great on bass.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is regarded as decent (≈4/5) while recording quality is poor (≈2/5); weighted average yields a mid‑range rating and mixed sentiment from the three reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noisy auditorium, indistinct bootleg sound, low clarity, muffled instruments, occasional dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall a decent performance though the poor audio masks many details; pacing and energy are viewed positively by listeners.
